 LE SSERAFIM Draw Nearly 150,000 Fans Across North America and Europe as ‘Pureflow Tour’ Heads to Asia
 Oct 30, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Print 
 LE SSERAFIM have wrapped up the North American and European legs of their 2026 ‘Pureflow Tour’, drawing nearly 150,000 fans across 14 cities and celebrating a major milestone with their first-ever European tour. The five-member K-pop group played to packed arenas, delivered nine sold-out shows across the two regions and brought their music to major festivals along the way. With their latest single album ‘Made My Night’ continuing to gain momentum, Sakura, Kim Chaewon, Huh Yunjin, Kazuha and Hong Eunchae are now preparing to bring the celebration to Asia.
 And for a group making its European touring debut, selling out London’s O2 Arena is a pretty spectacular way to introduce yourself.
 The European leg opened with 15,000 fans filling the famous London venue, where demand was so strong that organizers released additional seating. It’s the kind of reception artists dream about when they visit a new touring market for the first time, and LE SSERAFIM arrived with an audience already eager to welcome them.
 The group continued through five European cities, drawing nearly 58,000 fans across the region. Their itinerary included major arenas such as Amsterdam’s Ziggo Dome and Paris’ Accor Arena before concluding at Berlin’s Uber Arena on October 26.
 For European FEARNOTs, the group’s dedicated fanbase, the concerts were an opportunity to experience the energy, choreography and musical personalities they’d followed from afar. For LE SSERAFIM, they represented another significant step in a career that has steadily expanded beyond South Korea.
 And they’d arrived in Europe with some impressive numbers already behind them.
 Across North America, LE SSERAFIM performed in nine cities and attracted more than 92,000 concertgoers. Eight stops sold out, including the SAP Center in San Jose, Chicago’s United Center and Newark’s Prudential Center.
 Those figures demonstrate the group’s growing live audience, with thousands of fans coming together each night to experience the songs and elaborate performances that have helped establish LE SSERAFIM as one of K-pop’s most recognizable acts.
 The concerts also revealed how the group has continued developing its identity as a live act.
 The setlist featured the high-energy “Celebration” and the fan favourite “Eve, Psyche & The Bluebeard’s Wife,” giving the members plenty of opportunities to showcase the synchronized choreography and commanding performances that have become central to their appeal.
 Then came a gentler moment with “Need Your Company,” written by Huh Yunjin with her fellow members in mind.
 The song celebrates the bond between the five performers, bringing a personal dimension to a show filled with spectacular production and energetic dance numbers. That sense of friendship has become an important part of LE SSERAFIM’s appeal, with each member contributing her own personality and talents to the group’s collective identity.
 There are plenty of moments designed to get an arena cheering, but a song about the people standing beside you can be just as memorable.
 The tour also coincided with the September 11 release of ‘Made My Night’, the group’s second single album. The project arrived to an enthusiastic response, doubling the first-day physical sales of its predecessor, ‘Spaghetti’.
 Its title track also made an impression on the Billboard charts, reaching No. 7 on Hot Dance/Pop Songs and No. 14 on the Bubbling Under Hot 100.
 For fans attending the North American shows, “Made My Night” quickly became part of the concert experience. The group performed it during the encore, giving audiences an opportunity to sing along to the new release while celebrating the end of each evening.
 It’s a particularly satisfying moment for an artist when a brand-new song already feels like a familiar concert favourite.
 LE SSERAFIM’s busy schedule extended beyond the headline tour, too.
 The group closed BlizzCon 2026 in Anaheim with a 13-song headlining performance, marking another significant appearance before an audience that stretched beyond traditional K-pop concertgoers. The show featured the live premiere of “Made My Night” and celebrated the group’s second official music video collaboration with Blizzard Entertainment’s ‘Overwatch’.
 The connection between K-pop and gaming continues to create opportunities for musicians to reach new audiences, and LE SSERAFIM’s relationship with ‘Overwatch’ has brought their music into a particularly colourful corner of entertainment culture.
 From the polished choreography of a concert stage to the animated world of a popular video game, the group has found ways to bring its music into different settings.
 And they had another major American stage waiting.
 Days after BlizzCon, LE SSERAFIM became the first K-pop girl group to perform at the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival in Las Vegas. Sharing the main stage with performers including Benson Boone and Snoop Dogg, the group introduced its music to another broad audience at one of America’s prominent annual music events.
 The appearance added another milestone to a year already filled with international performances, chart achievements and growing concert attendance.
 With the North American and European portions of the tour complete, LE SSERAFIM are preparing for another busy stretch of performances.
 The Asian leg begins November 7 and 8 in Macao, followed by two sold-out concerts in Taipei on November 14 and 15. The group will then perform in Singapore on November 28 and Manila on December 5 before bringing the tour to its scheduled conclusion at Japan’s Kyocera Dome on December 19 and 20.
 Those final performances will mark the end of a tour that has taken the five members across continents, introduced them to new concert audiences and brought their growing catalogue of music to some of the world’s best-known arenas.
 There’s plenty to celebrate along the way: nearly 150,000 fans across North America and Europe, a successful European debut, new chart achievements and historic appearances at BlizzCon and the iHeartRadio Music Festival.
 For Sakura, Chaewon, Yunjin, Kazuha and Eunchae, the ‘Pureflow Tour’ has brought another year of shared experiences and musical growth.
 And with Asia still ahead, the celebration has several more stops to make.
 LE SSERAFIM’s Remaining 2026 ‘Pureflow Tour’ Dates: 
 November 7–8 – Macao
 November 14–15 – Taipei (sold out)
 November 28 – Singapore
 December 5 – Manila
 December 19–20 – Osaka, Japan – Kyocera Dome
